verdict.rationale: Documentation confirms NVLink (5th-gen, 14.4 TB/s), 8-GPU DGX B200 systems with 1,440 GB total GPU memory, cluster/data-center-level GPU management software, and turnkey rack-scale solutions (DGX SuperPOD, Mission Control) for datacenter-scale training and inference; community reports corroborate real-world use and performance gains over prior generation. Missing for 10: independent third-party benchmark validation of the 3X/15X performance claims at scale.
